items.detail: 2 x 10, very light, rest 30 sec; total warm-up about 5 min

3 x 8-10, rest 75 sec. Lie chest-down on a low-incline bench, feet planted. With palms facing each other, pull elbows toward hips without lifting your chest. Choose a comfortable weight per hand; leave 3 clean reps.

2 x 12, rest 60 sec. Stay chest-down on bench. Start very light, 5 lb per hand or no weight if needed. Keep elbows softly bent, raise arms out to sides only within pain-free range, then lower slowly. Do not shrug or force arms above shoulder height.
2 x 10-12, rest 60 sec. Sit on bench, palms facing each other, elbows beside ribs. Curl without rocking, lower for 2 sec. Choose a light weight per hand and leave 3 clean reps.

2 x 10 / side, rest 60 sec after both sides. Use a single handle on a high pulley. Kneel on one knee facing the cable, use padding if needed; pull elbow down toward ribs without leaning or shrugging. Light-to-moderate resistance, 3 clean reps left.

2 x 10-12 / side, rest 60 sec after both sides. Lower pulley once after pulldowns; use single handle, palm facing up, elbow beside ribs. Curl without swinging or moving upper arm; lower slowly. Light-to-moderate resistance, 3 clean reps left.

items.exercise: Supported dumbbell split squat - slow lowering
items.detail: 2 x 6 / leg, rest 30 sec between legs and 45 sec between rounds. Stand in a staggered stance on the floor, feet hip-width apart side-to-side, rear heel lifted. Lightly hold the rack with one hand and a dumbbell by your other side. Lower straight down for 4 sec, pause 1 sec, then stand smoothly. Keep front heel down, pelvis level and front knee tracking over middle toes; use a pain-free depth. Choose a load that makes the final 2 reps challenging while leaving 3 clean reps in reserve. Start bodyweight to check control, then add weight; no wobbling or grinding. This is controlled leg loading, not a balance test.

1 x 45-60 sec @ bodyweight, rest as needed afterward. Put your back flat against a clear wall, walk feet forward about hip-width apart, then slide down until thighs are roughly 45-60 degrees below standing (not forced to parallel). Keep heels planted, knees over middle toes and hands off thighs. Choose a depth that makes the last 10-15 sec hard while you can still breathe and hold position; stop before form breaks. Press through both feet to slide back up. Skip if knee or back pain; muscle fatigue is the target, not joint pain.

Hold 20-30 sec, repeat once. Face the bench and place both palms on it. Step back, soften knees, then push hips back while keeping your back long and letting your chest sink slightly between your arms. Feel a gentle stretch along the sides of your upper back, not a pinch in your shoulders. Breathe normally; use less reach or skip if uncomfortable.

Hold 20 sec / side, repeat once. Stand tall and reach one arm forward below shoulder height, palm up, elbow softly bent. With the other hand, gently guide the fingers downward and back toward you. Feel a mild stretch along the palm-side forearm, possibly toward the biceps. Keep the shoulder relaxed; do not lock the elbow or pull hard. No pain, tingling or numbness.
